title: Tiny $70 Xteink X3 e-reader puts Silicon Valley to shame
summary: This article from The Atlantic reviews the Xteink X3, a remarkably affordable $70 e-reader that delivers exceptional value by rivaling much more expensive competitors in features and display quality, challenging Silicon Valley's tendency to overprice consumer electronics.
problem_solved: Makes quality e-reading accessible to budget-conscious consumers without sacrificing core features like display quality and reading experience
why_valuable: It demonstrates that premium technology experiences don't require premium pricing, potentially democratizing access to digital reading for millions of users worldwide
